decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement. Received 09/07/2018. A100; A101; A102; A103; A104; A105; A106; A107. Received 08/10/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The ventilation flue hereby permitted shall be subject to regular servicing and maintenance as well as best practice shall be implemented by the proprietors. Records of such works shall be documented.

Condition : 4 - The hereby approved A3/A5 Use Class floor space shall only be used as ancillary to the main A1 unit, and no more than 45 square metres of the floor space of the unit known as 96-98 High Street, Hounslow TW3 1NH shall be used as A3/A5.
description: Change of use of part of the ground floor to restaurant / take away (A3/A5) as ancillary to retail (A1) use with the installation of an external flue to the rear (amended description)
